method: Complete explicit reading of the current fixed manuscript: 251 main and 1622 SI running blocks outside the independently reviewed display/named-result and prior prose spans. Exact line contexts are SHA-bound. Covered original prose has its own inspected theorem; tracked connective text uses reviewed displays/results under their full hypotheses. Bibliographic exposition, research questions and conjectures are explicitly scoped out. The SI mathematical correspondence is complete. The frozen main remains partial because of its five author-held issues; its historical image counts and publication URL are recorded as editorial status. No source-wide mathematical coverage was inferred from root proximity or successful compilation alone.
